title: Showing Up
coreMove: Treat grit as the act of staying in the hard place after credentials stop helping.
sourcePressure: Separate initial selection from sustained return under pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking grit means toughness, elite credentials, or one heroic burst.

sourceAnchors.name: West Point Beast Barracks
sourceAnchors.detail: New cadets face a seven-week training stretch with days running from 5:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., no weekends, and little outside contact.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: West Point strips away the admissions polish fast; by nightfall, the test is who returns to the line tomorrow.

sourceAnchors.name: Grit Scale
sourceAnchors.detail: In 2004, Duckworth used the Grit Scale with incoming West Point cadets and found it predicted who stayed through Beast Barracks better than the admissions score.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The scorecard that looked less glamorous than admissions credentials saw something the admissions process missed.
